item.title: Report: Stags 0-2 Lincoln
item.description: Mansfield Town were defeated 2-0 at One Call Stadium this afternoon by an in-form Lincoln City side. Forward Rob Street scored for the second time this week to give his side the lead from the penalty spot, before midfielder Tom Bayliss turned home a close-range shot in the dying moments to seal the points for the Imps. item.title: Ticket information: Mansfield Town v Arsenal
item.description: Mansfield Town are pleased to confirm ticket information for the club’s Emirates FA Cup fifth round fixture at home to Arsenal. The tie will take place at One Call Stadium on Saturday 07 March (12.15pm kick-off). Season ticket holders will have priority access to purchase tickets from 6pm on Tuesday 24 February until 5pm on Friday 27 February. item.title: Youth preview: Stags v Notts County
item.description: Mansfield Town under-18s welcome local rivals Notts County to RH Academy on Saturday, as the young Stags look to make it seven games unbeaten in the Youth Alliance League (11am kick-off). The amber and blue are also playing for the Matt Salmon trophy, an award contested between the two sides in Matt’s memory. item.title: Field Mill Mania coming to Mansfield in May
item.description: A hotly-anticipated night of combat sports is coming to Mansfield on Saturday 30 May 2026 as a fully licensed open-air fight event will take place on the pitch at One Call Stadium.Spectators can expect an action-packed showcase of boxing, kickboxing and mixed martial arts featuring up to 36 bouts between rising and established fighters from across the Midlands, UK, and Europe.
